scope: Only fixedbase DebugPad Initialize/GetState; original upstream Npad source/configuration remains unchanged. General HID service/shared-memory support is not provided by this adaptation.

wire_contract.initialize: publicvoid; original SDK creates/activates DebugPad via HID. Replacement initializes one actual native disconnected producer.
wire_contract.get_state: publicvoid; nulloutput(detailResult0x30ca) or uninitialized(detailResult0x2aca) goes to originalpublicAbort. Emptyring leaves calleroutput unchanged; nonempty copies one stable32B state.

implementation.source: Complete existing native/botw_input/input.c publisher; no replacement packet/sampling algorithm.
implementation.owner: One processlifetime botw_input backing, bounded256KiB. Native defaults remain unchanged but no sources/configure/fullsample/sharedmemory or services binding is used.
implementation.publication: pthread_once creates and activates using nonzero real monotonic19.2MHz ticks, then atomicrelease publishes pointer. Only failed unpublished construction may destroy input.
implementation.tick: botw_base_v0_debug_pad_tick no-ops before initialization; normal frontend readiness cadence supplies a realclock tick to native DebugPad-only sample. Getter never creates samples.
implementation.getter: Acquire pointer; actual native typedreader copies latest under its mutex into hostlocal32B. After readerunlocks, checkedguestwrite preparation precedes memcpy. Emptyring does not prepare or write caller output.
implementation.errors: Allocation/clock/activation/sample/read/writepreparation failure uses fixedhostfatal. No fakeconnectedcontroller, handle, IPC response or gueststate diagnostic.

limits: Static/ownedCPU evidence does not prove gameplay or identify an actualGuestfaultsite.
DebugPad remains disconnected because no DebugPad hardware/source backend exists.
Original upstream touch/GameController Npad producer is not replaced or duplicated.
